Youth Jobs Crisis Fuels Protests in India

Protests are underway in India over the youth jobs crisis, with the Cockroach Janta Party demanding action from the government. The party's leader, Prakash Raj, has extended an invitation to other political parties to join the protests. The issue of unemployment among young people is a pressing concern in India, with many feeling that the government is not doing enough to address it.
